purpose: Declare one test per AC of US-19101 (FBS-222) driving rcf audit separation through bin/rcf.js over fixture git histories, so the FBS-222 Define round turns each declaration into a red test against the separation verb.
title: rcf audit separation: per-commit Hand trailer judged against touched path classes, PASS and FAIL lines, undeclared commits, bad ref and non-repo exits, --json rows, read-only and deterministic

testCases.description: rcf audit separation over test-author, builder and verifier commits on their own paths exits 0 and prints "separation: PASS 3 commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): test-author 1, builder 1, verifier 1, stage-keeper 0, neutral 0, undeclared 0, exceptions 0"
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation-stage-prefix.test.js::AC-19601-1: rcf audit separation over a DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW:, TEST: and FINALISE: branch exits 0 and prints exactly "separation: PASS 5 commits (base <b7>, head <h7>): DEFINE 1, BUILD 1, REVIEW 1, TEST 1, FINALISE 1, merges 0, transition 0"

testCases.description: rcf audit separation with a Hand: builder commit touching test/x.test.js exits 4 and prints "separation: FAIL 1 of <n> commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): <sha7> Hand=builder touches test/x.test.js"
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation-stage-prefix.test.js::AC-19601-2: a "BUILD: add test" commit touching test/x.test.js exits 4 with "separation: FAIL 1 of 1 commits (base <b7>, head <h7>): <s7> BUILD: touches test/x.test.js (class rcfTest, owned by DEFINE)"

testCases.description: rcf audit separation passes undeclared commits touching only src/ or only test/ and counts them undeclared; an undeclared commit touching both exits 4 naming both paths
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation-stage-prefix.test.js::AC-19601-3: a commit with no stage prefix exits 4 with "<s7> no stage prefix" as its only item, also when it touches only Markdown outside rcf/

testCases.description: rcf audit separation --base <missing-ref> exits 2 with "separation: bad ref <ref>"; outside a git repository it exits 1 with "separation: not a git repository"; an unknown Hand value is a violation "unknown hand <value>"
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation.test.js::AC-19101-4: rcf audit separation --base <missing-ref> exits 2 with "separation: bad ref <ref>"; outside a git repository it exits 1 with "separation: not a git repository"; an unknown Hand value is a violation "unknown hand <value>"

testCases.description: rcf audit separation --json prints a JSON array of one SeparationRow { sha, subject, hand, declared, classes, verdict, reason, paths } per non-merge commit with merge commits absent
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation-stage-prefix.test.js::AC-19601-6: --json over the five-commit branch plus a clean "FINALISE: merge main" prints six SeparationRow v2 objects in range order with exactly the v2 keys; the BUILD row is builder with production and hygieneTest; the merge row reads merge true, stage FINALISE, paths []

testCases.description: rcf audit separation writes no file, reads no network and no chain: two runs over the same range print byte-identical output and leave git status unchanged
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation.test.js::AC-19101-6: rcf audit separation writes no file, reads no network and no chain: two runs over the same range print byte-identical output and leave git status unchanged

testCases.description: rcf audit separation classifies a committed report under rcf/verify-reports/ as verifier evidence
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation.test.js::AC-19101-7: rcf audit separation classifies a committed report under rcf/verify-reports/ as verifier evidence

testCases.description: rcf audit separation classes a test-shaped file whose basename carries .test. or .spec. as a dotted segment, whatever follows it and at any depth, as test: a Hand: builder commit touching src/widget.test.d.ts, src/widget.spec.js.map or packages/app/src/widget.test.snap.js exits 4 with "separation: FAIL 1 of 2 commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): <sha7> Hand=builder touches <path>", a Hand: test-author commit touching the same path passes with --json classes exactly [test]; near-miss names src/attest.js, src/testing.js, src/inspector.js, src/contest.config.js, src/widget.testing.js and src/widget.spectrum.js stay production (gate 1 BH-1, FBS-222-DIFF-001)
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation-stage-prefix.test.js::AC-19601-2: a "BUILD: add test" commit touching test/x.test.js exits 4 with "separation: FAIL 1 of 1 commits (base <b7>, head <h7>): <s7> BUILD: touches test/x.test.js (class rcfTest, owned by DEFINE)"

testCases.description: rcf audit separation classes lockfiles as neutral at any depth: a Hand: test-author commit touching only package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, bun.lockb, bun.lock, Cargo.lock, Gemfile.lock, poetry.lock, uv.lock, composer.lock, go.sum, any basename ending .lock (exercised by flake.lock, Podfile.lock, pubspec.lock, mix.lock, widget-tool.lock), packages/app/Cargo.lock, packages/app/go.sum and services/api/poetry.lock passes with "separation: PASS 2 commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): test-author 1, builder 0, verifier 1, stage-keeper 0, neutral 0, undeclared 0, exceptions 0" and --json classes exactly [neutral]; near-miss names src/lock.js, src/flock, src/Cargo.lock.js, src/lockfile.json and src/go.summary stay production (gate 1 BH-2, FBS-222-DIFF-002)
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation-stage-prefix.test.js::AC-19601-2: a "BUILD: add test" commit touching test/x.test.js exits 4 with "separation: FAIL 1 of 1 commits (base <b7>, head <h7>): <s7> BUILD: touches test/x.test.js (class rcfTest, owned by DEFINE)"
